reason: Most of my business is repeat buyers who just call or WhatsApp me, and I quote them from memory in two minutes. Paying Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for a website and a quote desk does not fix a problem I actually have.
objection: A website alone will not bring me new buyers, and my prices change with the market every week, so I doubt an auto-drafted quote from a price list will be right without me redoing it anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it brings new paying buyers, like a trader in my line showing me actual new orders that came from the site, or a trial where I pay the monthly only after it gets me enquiries I would not have got otherwise.
